Group rides in Hawaii

7 recurring group rides around Hawaii: 7 road, 2 e-bike, 1 mixed. 4 roll on weeknights, 4 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Red Hot Ladies Roving Ride in Honolulu — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Kona Saturday Recreational Ride runs casual no-drop tempo, 13–20 mph, rolling hills.
